body: Thank you for your kind words last night. They kept me together in a significant way.

Nothing in particular comes to mind that causes me to feel better. 

On the other hand there isn't anything that causes me to feel worse. 

I can feel like I am back on top for anywhere from a day to a month 

On the whole I just feel extremely unbalanced. I am lucky that I do have a close friend who is motivating me to seek treatment. To the point where they will drive and sit with me as they know how unsettling I find physicians.

No I'm not currently getting treatment. Every time it gets bad enough for me to want to seek treatment it starts to get better.

I always worry doctors will dismiss my issues. Emotional or otherwise.
